mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_groups ( owner_id, title, category, study_method, region, place, capacity, current_members, recruitment_status, difficulty, meeting_days, meeting_time, duration, goal, participation_requirements, description, contact_link, created_at ) VALUES ( #{owner.id}, #{title}, #{category}, #{studyMethod}, #{region}, #{place}, #{capacity}, #{currentMembers}, #{recruitmentStatus}, #{difficulty}, #{meetingDays}, #{meetingTime}, #{duration}, #{goal}, #{participationRequirements}, #{description}, #{contactLink}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT SG.*, U.id AS `owner.id`, U.login_id AS `owner.loginId`, U.nickname AS `owner.nickname` FROM study_groups SG INNER JOIN users U ON U.id = SG.owner_id WHERE SG.id = #{id}

SELECT SG.*, U.id AS `owner.id`, U.login_id AS `owner.loginId`, U.nickname AS `owner.nickname` FROM study_groups SG INNER JOIN users U ON U.id = SG.owner_id WHERE SG.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY SG.id DESC
